trigger.finding: test_v0_mvp_exact_validator.MVPExactValidatorTests.test_r6_repair_diff_touches_only_declared_paths failed because it compared the historical R6 repair base to the moving descendant HEAD.

root_cause: R6 scope evidence is historical and immutable, but its regression used HEAD as the upper diff boundary. Any legitimate post-R6 control descendant therefore invalidated the historical R6 proof even though the frozen R6 subject itself was unchanged.
repair: Bind the R6 scope regression to repair_diff_base..frozen_r6_subject and additionally require the frozen subject to remain an ancestor of the current checkout. Do not change the R6 Work Order, validator, activation semantics or gameplay.
stop_conditions: Frozen R6 subject or tree is not reachable
The current branch no longer descends from the frozen R6 subject
Any R6 historical file must be rewritten
Any gameplay or foundation change is required
notes: This repair changes only the temporal boundary of a historical test. It does not weaken R6: the exact R6 diff is still checked against the original R6 allowed/forbidden paths.
